# Third-party notices

The macOS application bundles a separately executed FFmpeg binary built from
FFmpeg 8.1.2 with static x264 support. The build is licensed under GPL version
2 or later and does not use FFmpeg's `--enable-nonfree` option.

Corresponding source archives and license texts are included in the
`ffmpeg/` and `x264/` directories. Build provenance is recorded in
`ffmpeg/BUILD.txt`.
